intent: independent pose repaint from approved sprite target

submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
EDIT TARGET IMAGE1 is the approved cast/E/01 ready sprite at correct size. Independently REPAINT just the new pose for cast/E/14. Lock the face identity, painted style, camera, exact HEAD/FACE PIXEL SIZE, prop pixel size, costume design and overall character scale from Image1. This is a new hand-drawn body pose, not a mirrored/copied/warped frame. Do not enlarge the character to fit new extended arms.
Image2 is authoritative character identity and anatomical ownership: RIGHT hand = EXACTLY FIVE red rectangular cards with gold borders and flame motifs, LEFT hand = one bronze bell and red tassel. Image3 gives E profile camera; its old hand overlap is ambiguous, ownership follows Image2. Image4 is main approved hand-painted style/material/finish, ignore UI/scenery.
NEW POSE: Face/gaze strictly SCREEN RIGHT; anatomical RIGHT is near arm, anatomical LEFT is far arm. Settling toward idle. Upright short chibi body and head level facing right. Near RIGHT hand lowers compact five-card fan from chest to lower chest/upper waist, elbow tucked but fingers/base grip unobscured. Far LEFT hand lowers bell beside hip, bell bottom and red tassel remain clear of shoes. Knees almost straight in modest stagger; weight balanced on both planted feet. Ponytail and ribbon settle.
Keep bell hand behind body toward SCREEN LEFT while it raises/lowers, visibly separate from near talisman hand, no arbitrary crossing. FIVE talisman cards only: leftmost card, second card, middle card, fourth card, rightmost card. All 5 card corners/panels separable, thumb and fingers visibly grip shared bases; no sixth card. Bell handle has a clear natural grip.
Registration: same fixed orthographic camera and face/head sizes as Image1, root x50%, virtual ground y90% (x512,y920 at1024). Normal upright highest ponytail silhouette around14-15%; bend/lean may translate head naturally but MUST NOT resize it. Maintain clear 10% empty transparent margin under the invisible ground. Full body and props in square canvas, no zoom/auto-fit/crop. Two distinct short legs, clear knees/ankles/shoes and grounded support.
Native single square RGBA frame at least1024, intended1024x1024. Genuine transparent alpha. No background, ground plane, shadow, checkerboard, text/labels, particles, aura, glow, detached flame/projectile/trails, extra anatomy. Bright clean rounded high-quality hand-painted Taoist chibi, restrained gold ornament, no plastic gloss.
